language.label: Interface language
请检查后台服务连接: Check the connection to the server
登录已失效，请重新登录: Your session has expired. Please sign in again
当前浏览器环境不支持自动复制，请手动复制{{value0}}: Your browser cannot copy automatically. Copy {{value0}} manually
失败队列加载失败: Failed to load the failed queue
粘贴链接、@用户名或列表 ID: Paste a link, @username or list ID
支持用户名、@screen_name 或数字 ID，每行一个: Enter usernames, @screen_name handles or numeric IDs, one per line
输入 X 列表 ID 或完整列表 URL，自动获取列表成员推文媒体: Enter an X list ID or URL to archive media from its members
输入目标账号，自动获取其关注的所有账号并进行媒体归档: Enter an account to archive media from all accounts it follows
请至少输入一个有效目标: Enter at least one valid target
已成功入库 {{value0}} 个任务并开始后台下载: Created {{value0}} tasks and started downloading in the background
支持单条推文、批量用户时间线、列表与关注关系媒体高速入库: Archive media from tweets, user timelines, lists and followed accounts
解析后点击立即下载入库: Parse a tweet, then download its media
是否保存为自动归档计划（定期抓取）？: Save as a recurring archive schedule?
修改成功后需重新登录。: Sign in again after changing your password.
存储位置、网络代理与 X Cookie 集中管理，修改后点击右上角统一保存: Manage storage, network proxy and X cookies. Save your changes when ready
将重新加载服务器上的最新配置，当前编辑内容会丢失。: Reload the server configuration and discard your current edits.
选择媒体下载文件的保存方式与目标目录: Choose how and where to store downloaded media
控制代理连接、文件命名方式与下载相关开关: Configure the proxy, file naming and download options
配置主账号与备用多账号凭证池，用于规避 API 频率限制: Configure primary and backup account cookies to reduce API rate limiting
在浏览器中登录 x.com，建议使用独立浏览器配置或无痕窗口，避免影响日常登录状: Sign in to x.com in a separate browser profile or private window to preserve your usual session.
打开开发者工具：F12，或 macOS 上 Cmd+Option+I、Windo: Open developer tools: F12, Cmd+Option+I on macOS, or Ctrl+Shift+I on Windows / Linux.
切换到「应用 / Application」面板（Firefox 为「存储 / S: Open Application (Storage in Firefox), expand Cookies and select https://x.com.
复制 auth_token 一行的 Value 填入上方 auth_token，: Copy the auth_token and ct0 values into the matching fields above. Both must come from the same account and browser session.
保存配置后点击「检测 Cookie」，确认状态显示为有效。: Save the configuration, then select Check cookies and confirm the status is Valid.
auth_token 是 HttpOnly Cookie，控制台执行 docum: auth_token is an HttpOnly cookie. Copy it from the Cookies panel; document.cookie cannot read it.
退出登录、修改密码或 X 主动失效会话后 Cookie 会失效，按同样步骤重新复: Cookies expire when you sign out, change your password or X invalidates the session. Copy fresh values using the same steps.
一个浏览器配置只保留一个 X 登录态；备用 Cookie 可用无痕窗口或另一个浏: Each browser profile holds one X session. Use a private window or another profile to get cookies for backup accounts.
Cookie 等同于账号密码，只会保存在本地数据库中，请勿分享或粘贴到其他站点。: Cookies grant access to your account. They are stored in the local database. Do not share them or paste them into other sites.
X/Twitter 登录 Cookie 中的 auth_token，用于鉴权。位: The auth_token cookie authenticates your X/Twitter account. Find it in developer tools under Application > Cookies > https://x.com. Use ct0 from the same account.
X/Twitter 登录 Cookie 中的 ct0（CSRF Token），与: The ct0 (CSRF token) cookie pairs with auth_token. Copy the ct0 value from the same Cookies panel.
用于多账号轮询下载，降低单个账号被 Twitter 限流的概率。: Rotate downloads across accounts to reduce per-account rate limiting.
可点「批量粘贴」一次导入多个账号：每行一个，支持: Use Paste batch to import multiple accounts, one per line, as
已保存的 Cookie 在此界面会以 ******** 脱敏显示，新增或修改不受: Saved cookies appear as ********. You can still add or edit values.
如何获取 X Cookie（auth_token / ct0）？: How to get X cookies (auth_token / ct0)
保存或输入 Cookie 后可进行检测: Save or enter cookies to check them
此 Cookie 未进入检测队列，可能未填写完整或与其他 Cookie 重复: This cookie was not checked. It may be incomplete or a duplicate
或 JSON 数组； 粘贴后点「导入」，已保存的账号不受影响。: or a JSON array. Select Import after pasting. Saved accounts are preserved.
：只填一半的账号不会参与轮询，请补全或删除这一行。: : Incomplete accounts are excluded from rotation. Complete or delete this row.
JSON 无法解析出 auth_token / ct0，请检查格式: Cannot find auth_token / ct0 in the JSON. Check the format
没有识别到账号：每行应为 auth_token=xxx; ct0=yyy，或粘贴: No accounts found. Use auth_token=xxx; ct0=yyy on each line, or paste a JSON array
有 {{value0}} 行只识别到一个字段，导入后需要补全（缺字段的账号不参与: {{value0}} rows have only one token. Complete them after import; incomplete accounts are excluded from rotation
支持 http、https、socks5、socks5h，例如 http://1: Supports http, https, socks5 and socks5h, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890.
用户名或密码里的 @、:、/、% 需要 URL 编码；包含账号密码时会随配置保存: URL-encode @, :, / and % in credentials. Credentials are saved locally with the configuration.
限制保存到磁盘或远程存储的文件名长度，长推文文件名会自动截断。: Limit filename length on disk or remote storage. Long tweet filenames are truncated.
影响新下载文件的命名方式，已下载文件不会被重命名。: Applies to new downloads. Existing files are not renamed.
自动创建独立任务，重试已到重试时间的失败推文。: Automatically create tasks to retry failed tweets when their retry time arrives.
遇到未关注的保护账号时，使用已配置 Cookie 尝试发起关注后再归档。: Try to follow protected accounts using configured cookies before archiving.
开启后会把引用或转推中的媒体也纳入单条下载和批量归档；关闭时只处理当前推文本体媒: Include media from quoted and reposted tweets in downloads and archives. When off, only the current tweet's media is included.
开启后重复归档从上次成功位置继续，节省 X API 配额。: Resume repeated archives from the last successful position to save X API quota.
默认关闭：每次全量扫描时间线，已存在媒体自动跳过，并顺带补齐历史视频缺失的封面。: Off by default: scan the full timeline, skip existing media and fill missing covers for older videos.
切换失败推文自动重试: Toggle automatic retry of failed tweets
切换保护账号自动关注: Toggle automatic following of protected accounts
从上次记录处断点续扫: Resume from the last saved position
由环境变量提供，保存不会覆盖: Set by an environment variable; saving will not override it
集中浏览所有已下载的高清图片、动态 GIF 与 4K 视频原片: Browse downloaded images, animated GIFs and original videos
媒体库索引已达上限，当前仅显示最近的记录: The library index limit was reached. Only recent records are shown
没有匹配的媒体文件，试试调整筛选或搜索关键词。: No matching media. Try changing your filters or search.
暂无归档文件记录。完成下载任务后，媒体文件将自动在此呈现。: No archived files yet. Downloaded media will appear here.
配置定时轮询任务，定时扫描指定用户时间线、列表或关注成员，自动同步最新媒体: Schedule recurring scans of user timelines, lists or followed accounts to archive new media
您可以把常用关注的 X 博主、列表或推文账号加入自动计划，系统将按设置的频率自动: Add X accounts or lists to a recurring schedule to automatically archive their latest media.
确定删除计划 “{{value0}}”？已下载的媒体文件不受影响。: Delete schedule "{{value0}}"? Downloaded media will be preserved.
本页匹配 {{value0}} 条（筛选仅作用于当前第 {{value1}} 页: {{value0}} matches on this page (filters apply only to page {{value1}})
监控所有已创建的推文与归档任务、过滤检索并查看下载文件记录: Monitor tweet and archive tasks, filter results and inspect downloaded files
括号内为当前页的任务计数，全局统计见侧边栏与上方卡片: Counts in parentheses apply to this page. Global totals appear above and in the sidebar
Search title, username, error or ID...
当前浏览器环境不支持自动复制，请手动复制错误信息: Your browser cannot copy automatically. Copy the error details manually
任务处理存在异常或部分失败: Task encountered errors or partial failures
未知异常，任务未能成功完成: The task failed with an unknown error
文件清单过长，每类仅展示最近 5000 条记录: The file list is too long. Only the latest 5,000 records of each type are shown
任务未生成已下载文件记录: This task has no downloaded file records
